newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates SIAT A minus claims-paying ability.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates SIAT A minus claims-paying ability.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it assigned its A minus claims-paying ability rating to Societa Italiana Assicurazioni e Riassicurazioni pA (SIAT).

S&P said in a statement, the rating reflected their view that SIAT was strategically important to its parent Societa Assicuratrice Industriale SpA (SAI --claims-paying ability rating AA minus) and that, on stand alone basis, SIAT had an adequate rating profile with satisfactory business position, good capitalisation (although small in absolute terms) and moderate operating performance, offset by a high dependence on reinsurers.
-- The company's strategic role within the SAI group would continue and SAI would remain the majority shareholder.
-- The company would maintain its business position in the Italian market but its position in other markets would prove to be difficult to grow profitably.
-- Premium levels would be static in 1996, with new business compensating for reduced rating levels. The company should be able to achieve moderate growth thereafter.
-- Profitability would decline in 1996 in relative terms following the international marine underwriting cycle.
-- Capitalisation would remain at its current good level with additional capital injections when necessary.
-- No major changes were expected in the company's investment portfolio mix.
